subject: Physics
question: A tennis ball of mass 58 g arrives at a racket at 30 m s⁻¹ and leaves in the opposite direction at 40 m s⁻¹. The contact time is 4.0 ms. Calculate the change in momentum of the ball and the average force on it.
response_text:
m = 58 g = 0.058 kg, Δt = 4.0 ms = 4.0 x 10^-3 s. Take the final direction as positive: u = −30 m/s, v = +40 m/s.

Δp = m(v − u) = 0.058 × (40 − (−30)) = 0.058 × 70 = 4.06 kg·m/s ≈ 4.1 N s
F = Δp/Δt = 4.06 / (4.0 × 10⁻³) = 1015 N ≈ 1.0 × 10³ N

The racket exerts an average force of about 1.0 kN on the ball, in the direction of its final velocity.

correct_steps: an average force of about 1.0 kN
